summary.text: Christine Barber is a Democratic State Representative for the 34th Middlesex District, which includes parts of Somerville and Medford.
The Legislature's committee listing shows her as Chair of the Joint Committee on Environment and Natural Resources.

paragraphs.text: Christine P. Barber's official biography says she was a health policy analyst for a national health care advocacy organization before she was elected, working on access to quality, affordable health care.
It says she earlier served as a research analyst in the House of Representatives, drafting legislation including the 2006 Massachusetts health care law.
Her listed education is a B.A. from the College of the Holy Cross in 1998 and a master's in public policy and administration from the University of Massachusetts Amherst in 2003.

The biography says she is Co-Chair of the Women's Caucus Task Force on Justice-Involved Women, was named to the Massachusetts Autism Commission, serves on the advisory board of Emerge Massachusetts, and serves on the Somerville Democratic City Committee.
